title: Level-Specific Safeguard Matcher
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Choose the lowest of five textbook levels at which each of eight safeguards should first be required.

educational.topic: Graduated, level-specific policy for digital textbooks
learningObjectives: The learner will apply the level-specific policy by choosing the lowest level at which each of eight safeguards should first be required, correctly matching at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The five levels, level-specific policy, and graduated regulation, from Chapter 6.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Match each risk to the capability that first creates it, with a stacked summary at the end
keyQuestions: What is the first level with that capability?
commonMisconceptions: All safeguards should apply at every level from the start
Privacy review is needed only for chatbots
A product with no AI model needs no data governance
assessmentOpportunities: At what level should an accessibility check first be required?
At what level does a privacy review of student records begin?
An adaptive product uses fixed rules and no AI model. Does it need data governance?
Is human review of AI-generated lessons needed at Level 4?

controls.name: Level 1 to Level 5
controls.description: choose the lowest level at which the safeguard should first apply.

controls.name: Submit
controls.description: commits your choice. Two attempts per safeguard; only the first counts.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: moves on; after the eighth it shows your score and the stacked view.

controls.name: Show level definitions
controls.description: checkbox that shows what each level adds.

controls.name: Try again
controls.description: reshuffles the safeguards and starts over.
